title: Maltese legend of giants building the temples

tellings.quote: the Maltese legends in that area are that there were giants once on these islands and that they helped build these temples

plain: A man named Jay Anderson, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes a legend from Malta, the small island nation in the Mediterranean that is home to very old stone temples. He says the local legends hold that giants once lived on these islands and helped build the temples, a story that would point to someone other than ordinary people raising them.
